item.title: New Mexico Senate passes bill aimed at protecting drivers' privacy
item.description: SANTA FE, N.M. (KRQE) – A bill aimed at protecting drivers' privacy is moving on to the New Mexico House of Representatives. The Senate advanced the Driver Safety and Privacy Act, which prevents New Mexico law enforcement from sharing license plate reader data with federal immigration officers. item.description: SANTA FE, N.M. (KRQE) – There was another heated debate among state lawmakers, as a bill on universal childcare in New Mexico makes its way through the Roundhouse. item.title: Bill to help first-time home buyers in New Mexico moves to the Senate
item.description: SANTA FE, N.M. (KRQE) – A push to create more affordable housing and help first-time home buyers passed the New Mexico House of Representatives. House Bill 200 provides funding to the New Mexico Mortgage Finance Authority to give first time homes buyers $75,000 loans, for low-income borrowers in high-income counties. item.title: New Mexico Gov. Michelle Lujan Grisham makes TIME100 Health list
item.description: NEW MEXICO (KRQE) — Governor Michelle Lujan Grisham earned a spot on the TIME100 Health list for 2026. Governor Lujan Grisham was recognized for her role in implementing free, universal childcare in New Mexico. The state is the first in the U.S. to offer the program, providing care for children from six weeks to age 13. [...]
